info.title: Smart Lab and Room Booking API
info.description: Booking backend with Microsoft Graph one-way creation, rescheduling and cancellation of confirmed bookings. Confirmed events can invite the person the booking is for (OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE); room and equipment availability remains managed by the booking system. Outlook credentials must be configured locally; sync status is independent of booking status. University SSO and durable database remain adapter integration points. Recurring bookings are not supported yet. Demo authentication and memory data are local-development-only. All paths retain trailing slashes; request timestamps require offsets and responses use UTC Z. Identity includes university_email. Students, Admins and Managers book under the same rules; an Admin or Manager may also book on behalf of someone (student_id is the person the booking is for, created_by who created it), and only a Manager decides urgent requests and reschedules. A student may submit a request only when the induction for the resource, and any prerequisite induction it lists (for example Advanced needs General), is verified and current through the booking end. Every request starts as PENDING_APPROVAL and holds its slot during a review window (pending_hold_minutes, default 1440 = 24 hours, Manager-configurable per resource, capped at the booking start). An Admin or Manager approves or rejects it within the window; if nobody decides, the system approves it when it still follows the rules (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) and rejects it otherwise (AUTO_REJECTED_*). Requests for time that is already taken or held are WAITLISTED in submission order and, when the time frees up, become PENDING_APPROVAL with a fresh review window. Induction evidence is always reviewed manually. Bookings must start at least 7 and at most 30 days ahead by default; these values come from a RulesProvider (booking/rules.py, environment variables by default) so they can be changed without code changes. Authentication and resource-specific eligibility are separate. Verified induction expires a fixed number of days after approval (qualification_validity_days from the RulesProvider, default 120, one term); reviewers do not supply an expiry. Admin and Manager can query the audit trail of requests, approvals, changes and cancellations. The prototype seed has 2 labs and 20 independently bookable devices. A Manager has every Admin permission and can also configure booking policies, add staff accounts and deactivate accounts. Admins cannot use any Manager endpoint. Students, Admins and Managers are separate accounts whose role is fixed when created: students are never promoted to staff, and Admin and Manager do not switch. Creating, approving, automatically deciding, promoting from the waitlist and rescheduling all use one shared rule check (account active, resource available, valid time, booking window on create and reschedule, induction and prerequisites). A Manager can mark a resource MAINTENANCE or CLOSED (new requests paused, existing bookings kept) and list or export every booking. Staff accounts are created with Add staff (POST /admin/users/staff/). Equipment records the room it is kept in (room_id); a room's maintenance does not affect its equipment. Two sign-in entry points: students use university sign-in (demo: POST /auth/demo-login/, which refuses staff with USE_STAFF_SIGN_IN); Admins and Managers use the staff page with zID and password (POST /auth/staff-sign-in/). A Manager's Add staff issues an invite code that the staff member uses once to choose a password (POST /auth/staff-activate/); Reset access issues a new code. Password hashes never appear in responses. Outlook sync is one way. The system never reads changes made in Outlook, so nothing done there can bypass the rules or become an approved booking; if a person deleted the event, a Manager's reschedule writes it again at the new time. Invitations follow OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE (default allowlist: only OUTLOOK_ALLOWED_ATTENDEES are invited). POST /admin/outlook/check/ tests the Microsoft sign-in. Resources have an equipment category, and GET /resources/day-overview/ returns every matching resource's free and taken times on one day for the booking page filter and grid. Demo staff accounts use the password 123.

post.summary: Create a room or individual equipment booking request
post.description: Any active account: Admins and Managers book under the same rules as students and may book on behalf of someone else with on_behalf_of_zid; the booking belongs to that person (student_id, whose induction is checked) and created_by records the creator. Urgent requests (urgent=true, urgent_reason) may start inside the minimum advance window; they are PENDING_APPROVAL with reason URGENT_AWAITING_MANAGER, review_due_at null and hold_until = start, only a Manager can decide them (URGENT_NEEDS_MANAGER) and they expire at the start if undecided. Requires a VERIFIED, unexpired induction for the selected resource, and for each of its prerequisite inductions, through the booking end; otherwise 403 QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED (details.qualification_status, requirement_id; PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED adds prerequisite_id and prerequisite_status), including while evidence is still PENDING. The local start date must be from today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 7) to today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 30): BOOKING_TOO_SOON / BOOKING_TOO_FAR_AHEAD (400, details.earliest_date, latest_date, min_advance_days, max_advance_days). A user who already has an overlapping active request for this same resource receives DUPLICATE_BOOKING (409); terminal requests do not block rebooking and different resources remain independent. If no APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (reason AWAITING_REVIEW) with review_due_at = hold_until = min(start, now + pending_hold_minutes, default 1440). An Admin/Manager decides within that window; when it ends undecided the system re-checks the rules and sets APPROVED (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) or REJECTED (AUTO_REJECTED_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_REJECTED_BOOKING_RULES or AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT), reviewed_by SYSTEM. If an APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes WAITLISTED (reason TIME_CONFLICT or TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT) with waitlist_position. When time frees up (cancellation, rejection, expiry, rescheduling, an automatic rejection or a resource reopening) the earliest waitlisted request that now fits becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST) with a fresh review window, or REJECTED with the failing rule's code (for example QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED or ACCOUNT_INACTIVE). Only APPROVED creates an Outlook event. Undecided and waitlisted requests expire at their start time. HTTP 201 never means approved. Interval semantics are [start, end).

The old period is released and offered to the waitlist. A successful Outlook sync updates the existing event rather than creating another event. The new length may differ from the old one within the resource's max_booking_minutes.

A VERIFIED decision sets valid_until to the review time plus the configured validity period (default 120 days, one term); it lets the user submit booking requests but does not approve any booking. A REJECTED decision requires a reason and rejects the user's undecided bookings (PENDING_APPROVAL and WAITLISTED) for resources requiring this qualification with reason_code QUALIFICATION_REJECTED and the same reason, releasing their slots and offering them to the waitlist. updated_bookings lists every booking changed. valid_until is not accepted in the request; sending it returns 400.

post.summary: Approve or reject a booking request
post.description: Admin or Manager only; an Admin cannot decide their own request (SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN, 403). Decide within the request's review window (review_due_at); afterwards the system decides automatically. APPROVED is allowed only for PENDING_APPROVAL requests; it re-checks resource-specific qualification through the booking end and conflicts with APPROVED bookings and other active pending requests, excluding this request's own ID. A WAITLISTED request cannot be approved (REQUEST_WAITLISTED, 409); it moves up in order. REJECTED (reason required) may be applied to PENDING_APPROVAL or WAITLISTED requests; rejecting a pending request offers its time to the next waitlisted request. BOOKING_HOLD_CONFLICT (409) includes details.hold_until; BOOKING_CONFLICT (409) indicates an approved blocker. Nobody can decide a request that is for them or that they created (403 SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN). Urgent requests can be decided only by a Manager (403 URGENT_NEEDS_MANAGER).

409.description: Missing valid qualification, approved or pending-request conflict, REQUEST_WAITLISTED, or invalid booking state. Approval re-runs the shared rule check: ACCOUNT_INACTIVE (the requester's account was deactivated) or QUALIFICATION_NOT_VERIFIED (details.qualification_status, including PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED).

patch.summary: Deactivate or reactivate an account (Manager only)
patch.description: Active Manager only. Send active (and optionally role, which must equal the current role). Roles are fixed when an account is created: Students, Admins and Managers are separate accounts, so any role change returns 409 ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED; to replace someone, add a new staff account and deactivate the old one. Takes effect on the user's next request; a deactivated user receives 401. Managers cannot change their own status (SELF_MODIFICATION_FORBIDDEN, 403), and at least one active Manager must remain (LAST_MANAGER, 409). Deactivating a student rejects their undecided (pending and waitlisted) requests with ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED and promotes the waitlist; approved bookings are kept. Every change writes a USER_UPDATED audit record with previous and new values.

BearerAuth.description: Signed demonstration token expires after 3600 seconds. Actual SSO authentication is supplied by a future server-side adapter.

prerequisite_ids.description: Inductions that must be verified and current before evidence for this one is accepted or verified, and before resources that need it can be booked.

pending_hold_minutes.description: Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

status.description: Set by a Manager. Only AVAILABLE accepts new requests, approvals and waitlist promotions; pending requests that reach their review deadline while the resource is unavailable are rejected automatically; approved bookings are kept.

status_reason.description: Shown to students while MAINTENANCE or CLOSED.

room_id.description: Equipment only: the room it is kept in (null for rooms). Used for grouping; a room's status does not affect its equipment.

category.description: Equipment type for the booking page filter (e.g. Microscopy, Fabrication). Rooms: null.

valid_until.description: Set by the server when VERIFIED: review time plus the configured validity period. Null for PENDING or REJECTED. Bookings must end no later than this time.

effective_status.description: Current derived status, including expiry; the stored review status remains in status.

file_url.description: Private API path; Bearer authentication is still required.

file.description: PDF, PNG or JPEG, at most 5 MiB; validated by the server.

status.description: PENDING_APPROVAL is an undecided request that holds its slot until review_due_at; WAITLISTED is queued behind an earlier booking or request and never holds a slot; only APPROVED is confirmed. WAITING_QUALIFICATION is kept for old data only and is no longer created.

reason_code.description: Why the request is in its status, e.g. AWAITING_REVIEW, AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW, AUTO_REJECTED_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_BOOKING_RULES, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT, TIME_CONFLICT, TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT, PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST, QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED, ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, START_TIME_PASSED, CANCELLED_BY_USER, CANCELLED_BY_STAFF.

review_due_at.description: End of the Admin review window for a PENDING_APPROVAL request (same as hold_until). After it the system approves or rejects the request automatically.

reviewed_by.description: Id of the Admin/Manager who decided, or SYSTEM for an automatic decision.

hold_until.description: Historical hold deadline; use hold_active to determine current occupancy.

hold_active.description: PENDING_APPROVAL and hold_until strictly later than server time.

blocks_slot.description: True for APPROVED or a pending request whose review window is active. Never true for WAITLISTED.

waitlist_position.description: 1-based place among waitlisted requests overlapping this one on the same resource, in submission order. Null unless WAITLISTED.

created_by.description: Who created the request. student_id is the person it is for; an Admin or Manager may book on behalf of someone. null for records created before 1.10.0 (migration 004 fills it with student_id).

booked_for.description: The person the booking is for (student_id).

on_behalf.description: true when created_by differs from student_id.

urgent.description: Urgent request: starts inside the minimum advance window; only a Manager can decide it; never decided automatically.

on_behalf_of_zid.description: Admin/Manager only: book for the active account with this zID (403 FORBIDDEN for students; 404 PERSON_NOT_FOUND; 409 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE). Eligibility is checked for that person.

urgent.description: Urgent request for a start sooner than the minimum advance window (URGENT_NOT_NEEDED if the start is inside the normal window). Requires urgent_reason; the time must be free (409 BOOKING_CONFLICT, no waitlist).

hold_until.description: Latest blocking hold deadline for TEMPORARILY_HELD; otherwise null.

held_by_me.description: True only when all blocking holds belong to the current user.

requested_by_me.description: True when the current user already has an overlapping active request for this resource; clients must not submit it again.

can_request.description: true only for a student whose induction (and its prerequisites) is verified and current and when the resource is AVAILABLE. Always false for staff.

qualification_status.description: Current resource eligibility; request submission additionally checks validity through the selected end time. PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED means a prerequisite induction (see missing_prerequisite_id) is not verified and current.

earliest_date.description: First local date a booking may start on (today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS).

latest_date.description: Last local date a booking may start on (today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS).

missing_prerequisite_id.description: Set when qualification_status is PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED: the requirement to complete first.

sso_connected.description: Always false; university SSO is not integrated yet.

staff_sign_in_enabled.description: Admins and Managers can sign in on the staff page with zID and password.

configured.description: Local configuration exists; does not prove valid Graph authorization.

last_check.description: Latest connection check in this server process; reading this page never calls Microsoft.

items.description: One row per synchronised booking, failures first (development view).

pending_hold_minutes.description: Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

actor_id.description: User UUID, or SYSTEM for automatic time processing and calendar sync.

action.description: For example BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_APPROVED, BOOKING_REJECTED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_REEVALUATED, BOOKING_TIME_PROCESSED, QUALIFICATION_SUBMITTED, QUALIFICATION_VERIFIED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, RESOURCE_BOOKING_POLICY_UPDATED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_SUCCEEDED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_FAILED, DEMO_STUDENT_CREATED.

details.description: Action-specific values such as status, reason_code, reason, old/new times or valid_until.

actor.description: Null for SYSTEM or an unknown user.

role.description: Optional; must equal the current role. Roles are fixed when the account is created, so a different value returns 409 ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED.

active.description: false locks the account out on its next request and rejects a student's undecided requests (ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED); true restores it.

reason.description: Required for MAINTENANCE and CLOSED; shown to students. Ignored for AVAILABLE.

affected_bookings.description: Future approved or undecided bookings on this resource, kept as they are so the Manager can decide whether to cancel them (POST /bookings/{id}/cancel/ marks them CANCELLED_BY_STAFF).

inductions.description: Every induction requirement with this person's current status.

induction_status.description: VERIFIED only when every induction is verified and not expired. Only meaningful for students.

is_staff.description: true for ADMIN and MANAGER (staff accounts, which do not book).

activation_status.description: Staff only (null for students): whether they have chosen a password with their invite code.

invite_code.description: Staff awaiting activation only: the code a Manager hands over. Null once activated and for students.

code.description: TOKEN_EXPIRED, OUTLOOK_LOGIN_EXPIRED, OUTLOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED, GRAPH_HTTP_403, OUTLOOK_CALENDAR_READ_ONLY, GRAPH_NETWORK_ERROR, ...

booked_by.description: Set only when staff booked on behalf of someone.

invited.description: Whether the person receives a meeting invitation (OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE).

room_name.description: Equipment: the room it is kept in.

qualification_status.description: Current resource eligibility; request submission additionally checks validity through the selected end time. PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED means a prerequisite induction (see missing_prerequisite_id) is not verified and current.

hold_until.description: Latest blocking hold deadline for TEMPORARILY_HELD; otherwise null.

held_by_me.description: True only when all blocking holds belong to the current user.

requested_by_me.description: True when the current user already has an overlapping active request for this resource; clients must not submit it again.

categories.description: Equipment types in use, for the filter.

results.description: Rooms first, then equipment, by name.
